entries.reason: The public compound construction succeeds, but the current single-body corpus verifier receives two parts from its x_t and cannot yet perform a compound-aware structural comparison.
entries.evidence: PK_BODY_make_compound returned success; PK_PART_receive_b returned partCount=2. The single-body CorpusCaseSpec contract rejects this rather than collapsing the parts.
entries.recheckWhen: Add a compound-specific case contract that verifies member ownership, part identity, shell counts and compound receive semantics.

entries.reason: The hand-authored relation graph is rejected before a valid body is returned.
entries.evidence: PK_BODY_create_topology_2 returned error 5014 for the two-shell general-body probe; no x_t was retained.
entries.recheckWhen: A documented topology graph seed with valid relation ordering is available.

entries.reason: Rebuilding a graph returned a create fault even though a body handle was reported, so it is not promoted as a successful fixture.
entries.evidence: The probe reported n_create_faults=1, state=16401 and n_topols=37; the case contract rejects create faults.
entries.recheckWhen: Topology relation and create-fault semantics are mapped and the rebuilt graph has zero faults.

entries.reason: The candidate producer exists only in the PKToy binding and has no matching declaration in the checked-in Parasolid header/runtime contract.
entries.evidence: GenerateParasolidApiCoverage reports PK_FACE_create_neutral_sheet as binding-only; no callable header signature is available for a legal probe.
entries.recheckWhen: A matching header declaration and runtime entry point are added.

entries.reason: The Euler operation creates a body in memory, but the checked-in runtime aborts during corpus host self-receive/body comparison for this disconnected vertex-loop state.
entries.evidence: A standalone host probe returned process exit 139 after PK_FACE_euler_make_loop succeeded and before a diagnostics record could be written; no legal fixture is retained.
entries.recheckWhen: The runtime provides stable receive/compare behavior for isolated vertex loops or the host gains a topology-specific verifier.

entries.reason: The operation requires a wireframe edge collection; passing the four edges owned by a sheet face is rejected by the runtime and does not produce a new face set.
entries.evidence: PK_EDGE_make_faces_from_wire returned error 914 for the closed sheet boundary edge probe; no fixture was retained.
entries.recheckWhen: A legal public wireframe producer supplies a closed edge set accepted by PK_EDGE_make_faces_from_wire.

entries.reason: The current runtime does not accept deletion of the newly created ring loop through the sheet-body deletion operation.
entries.evidence: PK_LOOP_delete_from_sheet_body returned PK_ERROR_unsuitable_loop (1061) after PK_FACE_euler_make_ring_loop succeeded; no fixture was retained.
entries.recheckWhen: A documented interior-loop producer and legal deletion sequence is available.

entries.reason: Sheet boundary vertices already own the geometry required by this state, so attaching a new point is rejected by the runtime.
entries.evidence: PK_VERTEX_attach_points returned PK_ERROR_geom_not_needed (64) for the first sheet vertex and a newly created point; no fixture was retained.
entries.recheckWhen: A legal point-less vertex producer is available, allowing PK_VERTEX_attach_points to create persistent point ownership.

notes: No compound x_t is promoted as a single-body fixture until the dedicated verifier exists.
